name: Gustbark
description: Stand with the feet apart like two courtiers facing each other and a stick poised in each hand.

name: Blaze Returnarc
description: Draw the first stick and the second in one sweeping arc of the arms.

name: Barkinsight
description: Breathe in two beats and note which stick is first by the pulse in each wrist.

name: Waninggrain
description: Take a returning stick in the left hand and pass it across to the right in the same moment.

name: Facet Woodgrain
description: Throw two sticks on arcs that return along the same lane a breath apart.

name: Chime Loopback
description: Cross the two flights in front of the foe's eyes so their stance breaks to the side.

name: Chime Arc
description: Hold both sticks to mirrored arcs through the whole flight so one foe is struck from each side.

name: Berserk Crookend
description: Strike with the first stick to open the guard and the second to land the decisive blow.

name: Doctrine Trailingedge
description: Cast the pair in a wide ring about a spot and let each pass mark a line of cutting qi.

name: Nova Sweptwing
description: Send the second stick through the very hole the first has driven in a prepared guard and pierce it.

name: Granite Hover
description: Plant the feet on a ridge crest as a hawk sits a branch and sway with the air.

name: Waning Tipwing
description: Watch a floating leaf on the nearest water and learn the current's path across the field.

name: Novawood
description: Pinch the wing tip like a feather and loose it upward along the hawk's climb.

name: Veritygrain
description: Let the returning stick settle into a palm held low like a hand at the water's edge.

name: Impenetrable Wingarm
description: Hold firm against a blow as a river stone holds against the current and let it slide.

name: Chime Cycle
description: Cast the stick high then let it stoop onto the foe and come back down the same line.

name: Thorn Curveback
description: Curve the stick round a foe's ankles in a bend and tug so their feet are drawn together.

name: Devastating Return
description: Skim the stick along a bank and let it rebound into a foe standing in the shallows.

name: Woodwrath
description: Dive the stick from above on a line that follows the bend of the river and strikes cleanly.

name: Circling Scourge
description: Cast the stick to run with the river's pull and rake the whole bank downstream.

name: Vanishing Leadingedge
description: Throw and follow the first arc in a single streak to arrive where the stick turns and take it there.

name: Might Crookend
description: Pace along one line and then the next so the body is aligned with both flights.

name: Hoverscourge
description: Hold the stick high with the elbow forward and the wing tip pointing straight at the sky.

name: Verity Leadingedge
description: Feel through the field of qi the exact point where two flights must cross.

name: Woodscourge
description: Throw one stick along a high track and one along a low track toward a single foe.

name: Mastering Hover
description: Run two sticks side by side past an arm so it is pressed to the body between them.

name: Blaze Elbowbend
description: Swap the two sticks onto each other's tracks mid-flight so the foe's read of them is false.

name: Novagrain
description: Keep two sticks on parallel rails and feed them back and forth like shuttles through a loom.

name: Grainvalor
description: Cross two rails over a lane so a foe who steps on the junction is cut from both.

name: Corroding Curveback
description: Close both flights on one point where their cutting qi sums into a blow no armor can turn.

name: Returnflash
description: Stand with the weight low and the hands out at the sides like a dish held level.

name: Prescient Trailingedge
description: Hold the two sticks in the hands and feel which is heavier before choosing which goes first.

name: Gust Arc
description: Pivot on the outer foot along the rim of an imagined bowl around the foe.

name: Brutalizing Woodgrain
description: Let each stick roll off the fingertips on the same side and follow the rim of the dish.

name: Beneficent Elbowbend
description: Catch the returning stick in a deep cupped palm so its spin dies in the bowl of the hand.

name: Gust Wingarm
description: Cast both sticks to rise at the sides of the foe and fall together upon the center.

name: Iron Loopback
description: Let the two returning sticks meet at a foe's wrist like blades and shear its grip.

name: Brutalizing Tipwing
description: Skip the stick across the low floor of a dip in the ground and up into a foe's shins.

name: Flintlike Returnarc
description: Drop both sticks into a crossed guard before the body and brace behind them with qi.

name: Arcspine
description: Clamp a foe's weapon between two sticks that close on it from each side and hold fast.

name: Slag Sweptwing
description: Cast the pair around a body of foes so they close from the rim toward the center.

name: Overpowering Return
description: Close both returning sticks across a foe's guard so the weapon cannot rise until the pair is recalled.

name: Cycleruin
description: Carry the sticks with wing tips up like folded pinions so any cast is a single motion away.

name: Curverespite
description: Spread the arms to their full length and take the foe's distance against them.

name: Gust Cycle
description: Hop lightly sideways between casts so the feet are never where the foe expects.

name: Glintgrain
description: Cross the wrists in front of the chest and fling the sticks outward from the crossing.

name: Impervious Woodgrain
description: Cuff an incoming blade aside with the back of the wing as with a pinion.

name: Blaze Arc
description: Throw a rapid series of sticks in turn so the air about the foe is never clear.

name: Invincible Elbowbend
description: Keep a stick orbiting overhead to knock down arrows and thrown stones from above.

name: Berserk Hover
description: Take a missile on a returning stick's flat and send it back along its own flight.

name: Ponderous Cycle
description: Beat the air with a thicket of orbiting sticks until no foe can step through it.

name: Equipoise Wingarm
description: Cast many sticks into a woven lattice over a field and make every crossing a cut.

name: Glintreturn
description: Line two sticks one behind the other so the front one hides the one that follows.

name: Hour Circling
description: Chain casts and catches in an unbroken rope of flights that never lets the foe breathe.

name: Slagcycle
description: Cast a full flight of sticks that fills the court and cuts down every foe within its span.

name: Perceptive Trailingedge
description: Hold the gaze fixed on one point while the arms and legs ready the throw.

name: Veritybark
description: Sketch two arcs in the mind from the same hand to the same mark.

name: Might Leadingedge
description: Close the distance in three light bounding steps without breaking the gaze.

name: Pitiless Tipwing
description: Let go of both sticks so lightly that the foe cannot tell the moment of the throw.

name: Ferocious Curveback
description: Steer the stick with the eye alone along an arc that follows the foe's moving shoulder.

name: Webbing Circling
description: Call one stick home early so the foe leans the wrong way into the second.

name: Murkreturn
description: Hold a hard gaze while the sticks circle so the foe's eyes follow the wrong one.

name: Arcruin
description: Throw two arcs together and recall them apart so both strike a foe from behind.

name: Unerring Crookend
description: Send a stick through a crowd and know from its path each foe's position by its brush.

name: Glinthover
description: Cast the pair and cross the gap between the thrower and the mark within one held glance.

name: Woodrespite
description: Breathe in time with the wind and let the bearing for the cast settle in the chest.

name: Granite Sweptwing
description: Set the feet wide on bare ground where no cover shelters the thrower from the wind.

name: Brutalizing Returnarc
description: Pinch the stick on the side facing the wind so it parts the air as it goes.

name: Nova Loopback
description: Let go of the stick at the end of a long stride with the whole body behind it.

name: Discerning Tipwing
description: Mark a far ridge as the place where the stick must turn and begin to come home.

name: Nova Return
description: Hold the stick on its bearing across a vast flight so it strikes a very distant foe.

name: Woodgrain Reckoning
description: Throw straight into the wind so the stick splits it and leaves a calm lane behind.

name: Trailingedge Nerve
description: Hook a foe at the plateau lip and haul them back from or over the edge.

name: Gustgrain
description: Throw to a distance sworn in advance and strike there and return exactly to the hand.

name: Decimating Returnarc
description: Cast the stick over open ground so it sweeps the whole span in a single long return.

name: Eviscerating Hover
description: Hold the stick steady on one bearing until it pierces every guard laid across the path.

name: Buoying Crookend
description: Stand square to the full gale and let its strength tell through the soles and the arms.

name: Brutalizing Curveback
description: Wait for the peak of a gust and cast in the instant it begins to ease.

name: Might Cycle
description: Bend both knees and drive the feet into the stone to stand against a hard wind.

name: Shattering Circling
description: Cast so the gale itself carries the stick out much farther than the arm alone could.

name: Fastening Sweptwing
description: Throw as the wind turns so the stick loops and wraps a foe's arm in its return.

name: Returnhavoc
description: Throw the stick in rapid casts so the foe's raised guard is beaten down by the wind.

name: Glint Loopback
description: Ride the stick out on a gale and bring it back on the same wind to the hand.

name: Toxinwood
description: Pitch several sticks into a gale so they circle a region and strike any who cross it.

name: Devastating Leadingedge
description: Let the whole gale drive the stick back so its edge cuts through any worn protection.

name: Verity Wingarm
description: Speak the thrower's oath beneath the breath and set the bearing it names.

name: Chimewood
description: Draw the sworn bearing on the ground with the toe before the cast.

name: Lacerating Cycle
description: Throw flat and true down the sworn line without a flicker of aim away from it.

name: Ghosting Return
description: Step back onto the line after a cast so the next throw keeps the same bearing.

name: Elbowbend Mettle
description: Parry along the bearing so the blow is turned without the feet leaving it.

name: Pitiless Hover
description: Cast an arc that bends only where the oath allows and keeps true past all other winds.

name: Booming Crookend
description: Add the weight of the oath to the return so the stick lands hard and does not drift.

name: Overpowering Sweptwing
description: Wrap the stick round a foe's blade arm so it cannot leave the line the thrower holds.

name: Impervious Elbowbend
description: Throw a stick to circle the thrower and break the force of arrows from the wind side.

name: Hour Woodgrain
description: Keep the stick flying back and forth on the bearing so no foe may cross it.

name: Merciless Wingarm
description: Return the stick along the sworn line with a cutting edge that slices through braced shields.

name: Lotwood
description: Let the stick complete its sworn line and pin the foe where it passes until recalled.

name: Barkglare
description: Stand with the toes at the very edge of the plateau and the heels on firm stone.

name: Farseeing Returnarc
description: Scan the whole width of sky for cloud and bird and the lean of the wind.

name: Curvescourge
description: Pitch the stick up and out from the rim so it floats over the drop before turning.

name: Chime Trailingedge
description: Snatch the stick out of the air as it crosses the rim on its way home.

name: Glint Tipwing
description: Cast the stick over a steep drop to strike a foe on the ledge below.

name: Cyclespine
description: Hook a foe against the skyline and drag them to the edge by the return of the stick.

name: Remnant Return
description: Cast so the stick's shadow crosses the foe's eyes and hides the second cast behind it.

name: Eviscerating Circling
description: Send the stick far out across the sky and have it fall upon the mark on its return.

name: Blaze Curveback
description: Cast the stick along the whole rim so it sweeps the ledge clean of standing foes.

name: Nova Returnarc
description: Launch the stick over the gap and cross the open sky behind it in a single streak.

name: Meteoric Leadingedge
description: Stand in plain view with the weight centered and give the foe nothing to read.

name: Illuminating Trailingedge
description: Fix the bearing against a distant rock or tree and keep it fixed through the throw.

name: Wrathful Loopback
description: Throw from high overhead with a long swing that needs no cover to start it.

name: Gustcurve
description: Slip a cast with a single shifting step on bare ground and no cover to hide in.

name: Adamantine Curveback
description: Turn the blade in the open with the thick wing so nothing else is needed to guard.

name: Decimating Arc
description: Cast in the open with no shelter behind the thrower and trust the return to find the foe.

name: Ponderous Elbowbend
description: Send the stick round every bit of cover so no foe can crouch behind it.

name: Fastening Arc
description: Throw the stick so it loops a foe's legs and holds them to the thrower's bearing.

name: Gust Loopback
description: Throw stick after stick across a wide front so the foe cannot slip from the line.

name: Doctrine Crookend
description: Cast sticks in a vast ring on open ground and make the wind carry their cuts through it.

name: Tipwing Wrath
description: Return two sticks on one bearing so the second strikes before the first has passed.

name: Grainruin
description: Link casts to the changing wind so the stick rides out and back in one long chain.

name: Wingarm Wrath
description: Cast the stick across the whole open plateau and let its return reckon with every foe in view.

name: Remnant Sweptwing
description: Squint along the stick to see how wide a gap in the wind it will leave.

name: Hoarfrost Leadingedge
description: Pinch the stick with the thumb forward so the leading wing is the first to meet the wind.

name: Cycleblink
description: Plunge into the gap the stick has opened in the wind before the air closes up again.

name: Shattering Hover
description: Draw the sworn stick from the back of the belt in a single straight motion.

name: Obdurate Sweptwing
description: Hold the stick before the body in the gap it made so no wind pushes the guard aside.

name: Rumble Circling
description: Part the wind on the way out and let it close behind the stick for a swift return.

name: Hogtying Arc
description: Hook a foe into the calm gap the stick has cut and keep them in it.

name: Wedging Woodgrain
description: Throw with a hard thin edge that wedges between a foe's shield and the arm behind it.

name: Rumble Crookend
description: Drive the stick so fast that the wind before it breaks and the guard behind that.

name: Poisoned Curveback
description: Cast sticks round a gap in the wind and leave a lane in which any foe is caught.

name: Grave Returnarc
description: Part the wind and the foe's defenses together with a return no armor can turn.
